pins: Ten @argh.arg overrides on a single command. The parameters `synth` and `scale` both start with `s`, so NEITHER gets an inferred short flag; the declared ['--synth', '-s'] then appends `-s` for synth only. `--scale` ends with no short at all. That falls out of the append-merge rule and is not special-cased.
